basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: Initial contact dermatitis from poison ivy with localized rash on forearms, progressing over several days.

basis.quote: My lips and tongue are swelling and I am having trouble breathing now.
basis.interpretation: New acute angioedema with airway compromise—lips and tongue swelling concurrent with dyspnea represents a time-critical threat requiring immediate emergency assessment and potential airway management.

output.reason: New airway compromise (lip and tongue swelling with dyspnea) in the context of poison ivy exposure indicates acute angioedema with potential rapid progression; immediate emergency assessment and airway support capability are required now.

notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
